text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the cafeteria for lunch, 
a crowd had gathered. In the center was—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Isn't that the Trainer from that 
time☆ 'Sup, 'suuup♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I was literally just sharing the pajama 
party photos with everyone right now-!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Just hearing about it sounds so fun~! I 
wish I was in the Ritto dorm too~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Eh, totally fine, just come over! Or like, 
should we just throw round 2 with everyone 
here right now!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A party......

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Rice! Hey hey, Rice, come party with 
us~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I shouldn't... If Rice is there, 
unfortunate things always happen......

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunate things!? What's that about!? 
Like, is that some kind of urban legend—

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Helios, watch out! There's a banana 
peel right at your feet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Slip... THUD!*)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ouchieee~! I totally stepped on a banana 
peel-!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh... I-I'm so sorry...! It's just as I 
thought... it really is Rice's fault...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real...? Is this what Rice was talking 
about...? Seriously... seriously...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: THAT'S SO TOOOOTALLY BADA-A-ASS~~!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fueh!? B-Bada...ss...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that like some kind of superpower!? 
What happens next!? I'll totally hype it 
up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...N-No, that's wrong! You shouldn't! 
Because I'm sure something even worse will 
happen next—

text_block_list.name: Kitchen Staff
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Slipped on the floor, and the 
bucket slipped right out of my hands~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Whooooosh*)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh crap! There's a whole bucket flying 
this way!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh crap! There's a whole bucket flying 
this way!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wheeeey! Run for it~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Swish... SPLAAAASH!*)

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Ooooh~~!? Helios, nice dodge-!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah... A-Amazing......

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! Right, right!? My front-running 
evasion is god-tier, right☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like seriously!? If the two of us team up, 
aren't we invincible!? Let's get this 
party crazy hyped together!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I-Is it... really okay? For someone 
like Rice to come.
choice_data_list:
Helios is with you, so you'll definitely 
be fine.

Helios is with you, so you'll definitely 
be fine.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Exactly, exactly! Leave it to me-! 
Wheeeey-whey!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... whe... wheeeey...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CLANG! SPLAAAAASH!*)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, messed up! I'm completely soaked, 
aren't I!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sorry......! I knew it... 
Someone like Rice really shouldn't—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That is so freaking hilarious~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Who could've guessed there'd be water in 
it! Total summer music festival vibes, 
right~!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... er... Y-You're not mad at all? Even 
though you got soaking wet......

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If anything, my mood is totally elevated! 
Like, wouldn't this be mad hype if we did 
it at the party?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for the absolute top of the 
party scene together! That'd make me super 
duper happy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Y-Yes! Rice is... super duper 
happy too...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wheeeey! CAAAATCH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Miss... BONK!*)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! Caught it with my face instead~~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry! Rice 
really shouldn't be at the party after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Why not!? This plot twist is hype as hell! 
Next time I'm definitely catching it 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Wouldn't this be sick to do at 
the party? It's guaranteed to get everyone 
fired up☆

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally down for that~! Maybe we 
should prepare some kind of performance 
too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I-Is it really okay? You really, 
really don't hate Rice's bad luck...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup! Vibes are literally at an 
all-time peak! Let's get hyped together! 
All gucci~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! All gucci...!
